purpose: Qualify UIdetox against a remediated full-stack stress fixture with retained baseline evidence and historical named canaries.

intent.product_goal: Provide a runnable B2B operations stress fixture in its remediated state, retaining historical multi-layer slop evidence while preserving verified frontend, API, and database behavior.
intent.audience: UIdetox maintainers, beta testers, and agent-harness evaluators
intent.primary_job: Verify that UIdetox can map and validate a remediated full-stack result against explicit historical slop provenance without regressing routes, interactions, or contracts.

operation_evidence: Literal frontend/src/api/client.ts wrapper calls resolved by UIdetox source facts
baseline_slop_families: emoji icon tiles and fabricated metrics
optimistic mutations that drift from persisted state
frontend, backend, and database operation mismatches
fixed-height records with clipped text and weak responsive behavior
remediation_targets: typed contract mismatches and coverage gaps explicitly accounted for
all named deterministic and runtime canaries detected or explicitly classified
all visible actions verified against persisted API state
canonical intent and baseline evidence retained
